name: expense-api
description: Single backend for expense claims: owns claims, expense lines, employees and their reporting lines, export batches and the audit log; enforces ownership, manager-team scoping and the draft/submitted/approved/rejected/exported lifecycle. Records employees itself: on every authenticated request it upserts an employee (id = the gateway assertion's sub, name = its username), so GET /me registers a person on first open; reporting lines are set by finance, never read from the sign-in directory. Deployed separately from the browser app as the only holder of business data. Sends no notifications and stores no files; export CSVs are generated on download. Does not issue tokens.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Sign-in: the gateway validates tokens issued by Thunder and forwards a signed assertion.
